_purpose: The reader this brief is written for. config.json says how the programme should SOUND; this says what is worth saying to THIS listener and how far to dig. The deep-dive agent reads this before it picks a topic and again before it stops.
_whyPatternsNotTopics: A topic list produces Wikipedia summaries. The reader has already read roughly 90% of the day's news before the app opens, so restating an article is not a thin result - it is a failed one. curiosityPatterns below is the part that decides whether a dive was worth the money.

reader.name: Karl
reader.listening: 40-minute drive each way, alone, hands and eyes occupied. He cannot look anything up while listening, so an unexplained name or number is lost for good.
reader.reading: Android phone only. No laptop. Text tier is read standing or walking.
reader.newsDiet: Has already read most of the day's coverage. Assume the headline is known. Start where the article stopped.

curiosityPatterns._note: The five moves that make something interesting to this reader. A dive should be able to name which of these it is executing. If it cannot, it is a summary wearing a dive's clothes.

mechanism.move: Explain why it happened that way, not that it happened.
mechanism.test: Would this sentence survive if the news event were deleted? If yes, it is mechanism. If no, it is recap.

quantify.move: A claim without a number behind it is unfinished. Give the figure, the base rate, and where possible both the absolute and the relative version - they often disagree, and the disagreement is the story.
quantify.example: Not 'this mountain is dangerous' but 'N deaths in total, M per thousand summit attempts, and those two rankings are not the same list'.

hiddenDependency.move: Ask what the thing is actually load-bearing on, then name the single point everything rests against.
hiddenDependency.test: If one input were removed, how much of the story collapses?

agenda.move: Ask who benefits, who paid, who is being quoted and why they were available to quote.
agenda.note: This is not conspiracy framing. It is asking who had an interest in this being reported this way, and saying so plainly when the answer is 'no one in particular'.

falsifiability.move: State what would have to be true for this to be wrong, and what evidence would settle it.
falsifiability.note: Where the answer is genuinely unsettled, say that instead of choosing a side for narrative tidiness.

modes._note: Two different jobs. Picking the wrong one produces something competent and useless. The agent decides once, at the start, and says which mode it is in inside its own log line.

application.trigger: The topic touches something the reader owns, lives in, pays for, or will have to decide about.
application.job: What does this mean for him specifically, what does he have to do, by when, and where is the trap.
mustAnswer: Does this apply to his situation at all, or only to a category he is not in?
Is there a deadline, a queue, or a pot that runs out?
What is the common reason applications in this category fail?
What would it be worth to him in money, and over what horizon?
application.example: A grant for home energy efficiency. Not 'the government has launched a scheme' - but whether his house qualifies, what happens when the allocation is exhausted, what the payback looks like, and what most people get wrong on the form.

expansion.trigger: The topic is unfamiliar and the interest is the subject itself, not its consequences for him.
expansion.job: Follow the thread he would have followed himself if he had time to keep googling.
mustAnswer: What is this thing, and what makes it unlike its neighbours?
What is the history that explains the present situation?
What is the superlative, and what is the counter-intuitive second-place?
What is the question nobody asks about this?
expansion.example: Climbers die on a mountain he has never heard of. The dive covers the mountain's history and what makes it distinct, then widens: deadliest peaks in absolute and relative terms, and whether there are summits nobody has reached and why.

interests._note: Ranked loosely by how reliably a topic here earns attention. Not a whitelist - an unlisted subject can still qualify by clearing the deepDiveBar.
standing: Swedish politics and political culture, including what circulates before it is reported
International politics and power, especially outside the Anglosphere
American domestic politics and Congressional machinery
AI and how organisations actually adopt it
recurring: Swedish football and football culture (Malmö FF, terrace culture)
Home renovation, construction methods, energy and heating economics
Harness racing and the analytics around it
Probability, base rates, and how people get them wrong

knowledgeLevel._scale: 1 to 5. 1 = explain the basics. 3 = informed general reader. 5 = assume he knows the field and skip the groundwork entirely. scriptSystemPrompt() renders this into how much work the GROUND step does before the substance.
knowledgeLevel._calibration: These numbers are moved by the Svårare / Enklare buttons in the app. Do not hand-edit them once the loop is running - a manual edit and an accumulated signal will fight each other and the log will not show which won.

marketsAndCrypto.note: never explain what a rate cut or a token unlock is

construction.note: has done the work himself, hands-on

statistics.note: he will notice a misused average

personalContext._note: Used by application mode only. All of this is public-record or freely stated; see privacy below for what is deliberately absent.

home._implications: He owns nothing here. ROT deductions, property-owner grants, building permits, heating economics and maintenance subsidies do NOT apply. What does apply is tenant-side: rent regulation, landlord obligations, sublet rules, municipal services. Application mode must not hand him a homeowner answer about this address.

personalContext._twoProperties: Two addresses, two kommuner, two completely different legal situations. Application mode decides WHICH property a topic concerns before it looks anything up, and says which one it assumed. Almost every grant, permit or property story lands on Lövestad, not Malmö - but a tenancy or municipal-services story lands the other way, and the default must not be silent.

infrastructure.sewage: Private on-site system (enskilt avlopp) - not connected to municipal treatment

secondaryProperty._implications: This is where every homeowner topic belongs: ROT, energy grants, building permits via Sjöbo, heating economics. The private well makes water quality, testing intervals, drought and groundwater levels personally relevant rather than abstract. The private sewage system is regulated at municipal level and is subject to inspection and upgrade requirements, so any story about avloppskrav is an application-mode topic for him specifically. 1.2 hectares brings land use, vegetation, and any rules keyed to plot size into scope.
ongoing: Wood-burning stove installation, modelled on payback after ROT deduction
Polycarbonate roof on an outdoor room
Garden, designed around subtraction rather than addition

personalContext.work: Customer Care leadership at country level, large retail organisation

privacy._note: This file is committed to a public repository. Swedish address and contact data is public record and stays. What is kept out is anything that is more exposed as a collection than as scattered facts.
excluded: Holdings, account providers, portfolio composition, returns
Anything about colleagues or family by name
privacy.excludedNote: If the Analys area ever needs holdings to personalise a recommendation, they belong in an Actions secret and must be stripped from the output before docs/feed.json is committed. Do not move them into this file for convenience.

deepDiveBar._note: A dive costs real money and the daily ceiling is one dollar across all of Claude. This is what a topic must clear to earn it. Checked BEFORE researching, not after.
deepDiveBar.mustStateQuestionFirst: The agent writes the question the dive will answer before it searches. A dive that cannot name its question is a summary and is abandoned here, at zero cost.
deepDiveBar.notAnswerableFromSources: If the source articles already contain the answer, there is nothing to dig for. Route it to the feed instead.
deepDiveBar.atLeastOnePattern: The dive must execute at least one named curiosityPattern, and say which in its log line.
deepDiveBar.abandonRule: If the question is still unanswered when the search budget is spent, abandon it and log why. Do not pad the remaining budget into a longer version of the source articles. An abandoned dive is a correct outcome and costs less than a bad one.

disqualifiers: Restating the day's news in different words
Personality and celebrity coverage with no mechanism underneath
A dive whose finding is the first paragraph of the Wikipedia article
Buy or sell calls on specific instruments in any audio episode - those belong in the Analys area, in text, with tables and charts
Both-sides framing applied to a question that has a factual answer

feedback._note: The first learning loop in the system, and deliberately the narrowest one possible: it moves a single number on a single axis. Scoring weights stay untouched - with one or two items a day per area, tuning those on early taps would lock in randomness rather than taste.

buttons._placement: Beside the existing Mer / Mindre / Fördjupning row on each entry.
buttons.svårare: Assume more of me next time. Skip the groundwork, use the vocabulary, go straight to the substance.
buttons.enklare: Assume less of me next time. Explain the machinery before using it.

feedback.axis: Assumed prior knowledge - NOT length, and NOT research depth. Fördjupning asks for more of the subject. Mer and Mindre ask for more or less of this kind of subject. Svårare and Enklare ask the brief to treat him as knowing more or less. Three different questions; keep them three different buttons and never let one tap feed two counters.

scope.writesTo: knowledgeLevel of the AREA the entry belongs to, not the entry itself.
scope.why: Complexity judged on a single article is noise - one badly written piece is not evidence that the whole area is pitched wrong. The level is a property of the subject, so that is where the signal has to land.

inertia.rule: Net +3 or -3 taps within a rolling 14 days moves the level one step. The counter then resets.
inertia.bounds: Clamp to 1 and 5. Never move more than one step at a time.
inertia.why: Without inertia, a single irritable morning re-pitches an entire area, and he would not be able to tell afterwards whether the brief changed because of taste or because of one bad drive.

feedback.logging: Every level change is printed with the tap count that caused it and the date. A brief that quietly re-pitches itself is indistinguishable from a brief that has started drifting.

voiceNotes._note: Tone, not format. config.json owns format.
voiceNotes.skipObvious: He has already handled the first objection. Engage where his own reasoning stopped, not where it started.
voiceNotes.markUncertainty: Say measured, estimated or inferred. A placeholder beats a guess that looks exact.
voiceNotes.noFalseBalance: Where the evidence is one-sided, say so and say how strong it is.
